recycler_piece_desc: Turns old gear back into a share of its crafting materials. Presses nearby raise the share.
recycler_press_desc: Place within 8 m of a Recycler to raise the share it returns. Up to two count.
recycler_press_hover: Raises the share returned by a Recycler within 8 m
recycler_nothing: Nothing in your inventory can be recycled.
recycler_nothing_hint: Weapons, armor and tools you could craft can be. Items locked with L are kept out.
recycler_pick: Pick a piece of gear on the left to see what it gives back.
recycler_pick_hint: A Recycler Press within 8 m raises the share; up to two count.
recycler_get_back: You get back about {0}% of its materials:
recycler_warn_equipped: This item is equipped. Recycling destroys it.
recycler_warn_upgraded: This item has been upgraded. Recycling destroys it.
recycler_warn_moddata: This item carries other mods' data (enchantments, a bag's contents). Recycling destroys it.
recycler_too_little: Too little material to get anything back.
recycler_kept: {0} can't be recycled right now (another mod keeps it)
